pages.title: Planetary Enchantments (Ad Astra)
pages.text: Five enchantments exclusive to Ad Astra planets. Each planet's mobs have a 12% chance to drop their enchanted book:$(br2)$(bold)Lunar Stride$() — Moon. Reduces low-gravity movement penalties.$(br)$(bold)Thermal Regulation$() — Mars. Negates cold and heat environmental damage.$(br)$(bold)Pressure Shell$() — Venus. Reduces acid damage and pressure slowdown.$(br)$(bold)Void Adaptation$() — Glacio. Negates alien debuffs and mining fatigue.$(br)$(bold)Stellar Shield$() — Mercury. Solar radiation and fire resistance on planets.$(br2)$(bold)Collect these on early planets to survive later ones.$()
